meta.title: Custom Groups
meta.description: Tailor-made guided nature programmes in India for families, friends, private groups, clubs, companies, international visitors, schools and universities.

hero.title: A trip built around your group
hero.lede: Tell us who is coming and what you want to experience, and we will design a guided programme around your dates, pace, interests and comfort.

groupTypes.title: Every kind of group
groupTypes.intro: Our default is a well-guided nature holiday, not a classroom field course.

families.title: Families
families.body: Gentle-paced nature days with safaris, short walks, birding, viewpoints, local food and enough downtime for mixed ages.

photo.alt: A group in a wooden boat poled slowly through the mangroves
photo.caption: Through the mangroves by boat, January 2012

friends.title: Friends & private groups
friends.body: Your own departure on your dates, with a dedicated guide, a route shaped around your interests and a daily rhythm you choose.

photo.alt: A group shares a South Indian lunch on banana leaves at a long table
photo.caption: Lunch on the road, January 2012

clubs.title: Clubs & societies
clubs.body: Birding, photography and natural-history groups: target birds, mammals, butterflies or macro subjects, low-light rainforest sessions and patient field support.

photo.alt: Birders with binoculars, a spotting scope and notebooks along a lakeside wall
photo.caption: Birding at a lake, January 2012

companies.title: Companies & retreats
companies.body: Nature immersion, team days, lodge-based wildlife, landscape trails and guided forest walks, planned around your schedule.

photo.alt: A group walks a grassland ridge above shola forest, with mountains behind
photo.caption: A walk above the shola forest, January 2012

international.title: International visitors
international.body: Route notes, comfort planning and guided wildlife time shaped around your flights.

photo.alt: Visitors from abroad birding from a quiet forest road at dawn, with a guide and a spotting scope
photo.caption: Birding by the road at dawn, January 2012

schools.title: Schools & universities
schools.body: Short modules, field courses and youth camps, led by naturalists who have taught environmental science.

photo.alt: Students sit and stand on a forest track writing field notes with their teachers
photo.caption: Field notes on a forest track, January 2010

sampleDay.title: A sample group day
sampleDay.lede: An example only. The rhythm changes with the season, weather, permits, ages and the group’s energy.
sampleDay.caption: A sample day on a custom group programme

rows.what: Guided safari, birding, wetland or forest walk while wildlife is most active
Breakfast, checklist notes and free time
Village, landscape, river, forest, tea, spice or viewpoint visit, depending on the region
Lunch and rest through the hottest or wettest part of the day
Forest-edge walk, safari drive, photography session, wetland visit or scenic drive
Optional night walk for frogs, reptiles, owls, moths and rainforest sounds, where rules allow

customise.title: What can be customised
customise.intro: Every custom programme is planned around group size, ages, walking ability, weather, forest access, travel time, food needs and safe wildlife watching.

options.note: We plan for the best chance, never a guarantee.

items: Airport or rail pick-up, where practical
Accommodation matched to your comfort and budget
Route notes, packing guidance and target-species lists

academic.title: Academic options when you need them
academic.intro: Our naturalists include past and present environmental-science lecturers at Bishop Heber College, Tiruchirappalli, with experience of nature camps and field-based learning for schools and colleges. <link>Meet the naturalists</link>

items.title: Short modules
items.body: Three to five day programmes introducing tropical ecology, species observation and conservation through time in the field.

items.title: Field courses
items.body: Longer programmes for colleges and universities, with field methods, data recording, student projects and review sessions.

items.title: Youth camps
items.body: Structured camps with age-appropriate nature walks, activities, observation skills and guided group reflection.

lecture.alt: Students and staff at a lecture during a field course
lecture.caption: A lecture during a field course, January 2012

shore-notes.alt: Students on a sea wall writing notes about the birds on the shore
shore-notes.caption: Field notes on the shore, January 2010

cta.title: Tell us what your group wants
cta.lede: Share your dates, group size, ages, interests, budget range and comfort level. We will suggest a route and a guided programme.
cta.healthBody: Every member of the group, students and staff included, needs comprehensive travel medical insurance and must tell us about any medical condition or allergy before booking.
